method: Started from 1,690 priced Kalshi legs in the next 36 hours. Kept legs priced 30–85¢ with edge of about −2.5 or better and no flags, one per game, and checked them against today's 188 newly collected expert picks and Polymarket top-trader positions. A leg stayed only if at least two of top-trader money, a published pick or model, and concrete matchup/injury reasoning agreed, with nothing disagreeing. Dropped for conflicts: Houston ML vs Kansas (five outlets on Houston, but Predictem takes Kansas +2.5); Knicks ML (Covers, but top traders hold $18.5k against); Kings ML (three outlets, but top traders on Toronto); Islanders ML (two outlets, top traders $1.4k against); Oilers, Senators and Wild (outlets split with Doc's Sports); Orlando City (five outlets, TheLines has Cincinnati); Seton Hall +4.5, Iowa State/UCF, Rice/Temple, NC State/Murray State, Dallas/Vegas, Vancouver/Seattle and UTEP/Air Force Under (experts or top traders split). Avalanche ML was skipped for a line-move flag, and Clippers/Spurs Under and Santa Clara for edges worse than −3. Friday NBA games had almost no published previews, so Friday legs are college football only.
honest: Every leg costs slightly more than its fair price (edge about −1 to −3¢ each), so expected return is slightly negative, and it gets worse with each leg you add.

ladder.label: Under 227.5
ladder.why: Steph Curry is out for several weeks with an oblique injury, and SI's Peter Dewey takes the Warriors' team total Under 110.5, saying the offense sputters without him. Memphis is on the second night of a back-to-back. Top traders hold about $6.6k on this Under against $0.9k on the Over.

sources.name: Sports Illustrated / Peter Dewey (Warriors team total Under 110.5)
